title: Kempu Chutney
description: Zesty and punchy Karnataka style red coconut chutney made with roasted Byadgi chillies, fried gram, and tamarind, tempered in hot coconut oil.

ingredients.name: Coconut oil, mustard seeds, jeera, hing, curry leaves

steps.instruction: Gently dry-roast red chillies and huri kadale on low heat until warm and fragrant.
Grind in a blender with grated coconut, tamarind, salt, and water to a thick spreadable chutney.
Temper with hot coconut oil, mustard seeds, jeera, asafoetida (hing), and fresh curry leaves.

storyOrOrigin: The quintessential red chutney that elevates crispy dosas, idlis, and paddus across Karnataka breakfast stalls.
grandmasSecrets: Using a mix of Byadgi chillies for bright red color and Guntur chillies for heat gives the best balance.
